payload.claim: MAIN WAS NOT GREEN WHERE IT COUNTS: for 9 days brain/ did not exist in HEAD at all. Last commit was a92ff42 (2026-09-16) while 13,676 insertions/145 files sat staged and 99 untracked, including all of attest.py, evidence.py, grants.py, events.py, invariants.py and tests/hostile/. The vault auto-committed its own markdown throughout, so the enforcement layer's records were versioned and the code enforcing them was not. Fixed in d9045f6..4d5aca6. Prove a fresh checkout with: git worktree add --detach /tmp/x HEAD && (cd /tmp/x && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -t .)

LINT IS RED ON MAIN, BUILD IS GREEN. npm run build passes (48 modules, 397kB js / 105kB gzip) but npm run lint (tsc --noEmit) fails: src/components/ChatroomDeliberationView.tsx:425 error TS2345 'unknown' is not assignable to 'string' -- Object.entries(squad.roles) widens the value to unknown and getAgentColor(agent) rejects it. CLAUDE.md states 'npm run lint && npm run build must stay green', which is currently false. Not patched during the backfill commit so the fix stays a separate reviewable change.

THE GLOBAL post-commit HOOK MAKES git status DIRTY AFTER EVERY COMMIT: each commit in this vault triggers a brain post that writes a new workspaces/<slug>/context/ctx-*.md, so a clean tree is unreachable in one pass -- committing N notes produces N+1. Observed 3 times in a row during the 2026-09-25 backfill. Expect the last note to stay untracked unless commits are made twice or the hook is scoped.

ROOT CAUSE OF THE UNCOMMITTED VAULT: vcs.auto_commit is dead config. const.py:231 sets {"vcs": {"auto_commit": True}} and vcs.py's docstring calls committing 'policy (vcs.auto_commit)' -- but grep shows the only two callers of vcs.commit() in the whole package are http.py:558 (task delete) and maintenance.py:62 (sweep). brain claim / post / start / end / task-create write markdown and NEVER commit. The one path that would commit is sweep, and doctor reports the daemon as 'stopped (never started)'. So every knowledge write accumulates silently, and 'brain claim' printing '(commit: 4d5aca6d)' is misleading: that string is result['verified_commit'], a provenance field echoing current HEAD (cli.py:197), not evidence a commit was made. 9 days of drift was the designed behaviour, not an oversight.

payload.claim: THE DASHBOARD NEVER HAD A REACT TYPE LAYER: @types/react and @types/react-dom were absent from package.json, devDependencies AND package-lock.json, and react@19 bundles no types of its own. tsconfig.json sets no `strict`, so noImplicitAny is off and `import React from 'react'` silently became any -- every useState in all 19 .tsx files returned any. Consequence: `npm run lint` passing is NOT evidence the dashboard type-checks, and CLAUDE.md's 'npm run lint && npm run build must stay green' was satisfied against a vacuous lint. Diagnosed via ChatroomDeliberationView.tsx:425 TS2345 ('unknown' not assignable to 'string'), which was a symptom, not the bug. Fixed in the types install; the same change surfaced 3 real masked bugs in App.tsx where a prop was passed under a name the child never declared (onDeployClick/onBrandChange/onCreated vs onOpenDeployModal/onToggleBrand/onAddTask) leaving three controls inert, because onClick={undefined} does not throw. Verify with: npx tsc --noEmit && ls node_modules/@types/react. Follow-up worth considering: add "strict": true, since noImplicitAny off is what let a missing @types package go unnoticed.
